title: BR Stock Rises 14.3% in Three Months: Here's What You Should Know
author: Na
description: Broadridge Financial Solutions (BR) gained 14.3% over three months, outperforming the S&P 500's 2.5% return. title: Can Nokia's Multi-PON Line Card Meet Growing AI Connectivity Demands?
